The pillar caps are flat-topped, providing a platform surface. In the immediate foreground a strip of closely cropped green lawn runs along the base of the wall. The sky is a deep blue-grey twilight tone transitioning to dark above. The contrast between the cool blue evening sky and the warm amber glow at each post creates a dramatic and appealing outdoor night atmosphere. Camera is at standing eye-level, slight telephoto compression, three-quarter view along the fence.
